basis_convention.source: Hamiltonians reconstructed from block2-example-data 06-SIAM and 07-UEG scripts.
basis_convention.siam: Site basis, preserving upstream g2e onsite value u/2 and ECORE=0.
basis_convention.ueg: Script-exact finite-basis UEG with ECORE=0 and no added background/Madelung term; complex plane waves transformed to real cosine/sine pairs for FCIDUMP export.

features.basis_convention_note: Script-exact 06-SIAM Hamiltonian. The upstream pyblock2 script sets g2e[idximp,idximp,idximp,idximp]=u/2; this FCIDUMP preserves that value rather than rewriting it to a different physical-U convention.

requirements.reference_energy_method: block2 DMRG example output, bond dimensions up to 1200
requirements.reference_energy_source: block2-example-data 06-SIAM output at commit ee9868b32ce1527a5067707f21f178128ad4d9b0; pyblock2 driver convention from block2-preview commit d0549a22839377b1658e581be3ac4dde8d951c10
requirements.reference_energy_note: Script-exact 06-SIAM Hamiltonian. The upstream pyblock2 script sets g2e[idximp,idximp,idximp,idximp]=u/2; this FCIDUMP preserves that value rather than rewriting it to a different physical-U convention.

features.orbital_basis: orbital 1 is k=(0,0,0); each subsequent +/-k pair is transformed to cosine-like then sine-like real orbitals
features.basis_convention_note: The Hamiltonian is the block2 07-UEG script-exact finite-basis Hamiltonian with ECORE=0. The complex momentum basis was unitarily transformed to a real cosine/sine basis before FCIDUMP export.

requirements.reference_energy_method: local exact FCI on the generated real-plane-wave FCIDUMP, cross-checked against block2 DMRG
